subject: Feedback on draft
text:
Hi there,
As customer, I read your draft. It looks useful. One idea may help. You might add a brief example. It can clarify your point. The current tone is strong. A small example could soften it. I tried it in my version. The flow felt smoother. Please tell me what you think. Does the example fit? Should we keep it? Your view matters. I can adjust if needed. Thanks for consideration. I appreciate your help.
Thanks,
